about:
13 Foods is based in Joplin, Missouri, according to its directory listing, though its mailing address is a post office box in Valleyford, Washington. The company does not disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders in publicly available materials.

The company specializes in individually quick frozen (IQF) beans and vegetables, offering whole-food products that retain natural texture and flavor. Its process involves IQF technology, which freezes individual pieces rapidly to prevent clumping and preserve quality. No details on facility size, production volumes, or headcount are provided.

13 Foods serves the food ingredient and foodservice sectors, supplying IQF beans and vegetables to manufacturers, distributors, and commercial kitchens. The company’s website references additional IQF bean and vegetable varieties beyond its most popular packs, but specific customer types or industry segments are not enumerated.

The company emphasizes ‘the natural goodness that nature intended,’ positioning its IQF products as minimally processed, whole-food options. No further differentiation claims or origin story are stated.
